design_rationale: Participants were randomly allocated in a 1:1:1 ratio using a centralized interactive web-based randomization system.

domain_judgments.rationale: Allocation sequence generation was centralized and concealed via an interactive web-based randomization system, with baseline characteristics well balanced across arms.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Randomization was performed by site personnel, using a centralized interactive web-based randomization system, which assigned unique blister card numbers reflecting the blinded treatment assignment

domain_judgments.rationale: Double-blind design with matching placebo was implemented, and analysis was conducted on an intention-to-treat approach using an appropriate mixed-effect model repeated measures framework.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The sponsor, study site personnel, and all contract research organization personnel involved in the conduct of the trial were blinded to treatment assignment. Matching placebo was used.

domain_judgments.rationale: Substantial and differential discontinuation occurred between active treatment (35-42% dropout) and placebo (19% dropout) primarily due to adverse effects, which could bias outcome estimations despite MMRM modeling.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: In the NAL 120, NAL 60, and placebo groups, 65, 58, and 81% completed the 8-week treatment... The most common reason for discontinuing treatment in the active groups was the opioid type side effects

domain_judgments.rationale: The numerical rating scale is an appropriate and standard validated measure for itch intensity, administered consistently across groups with blinding intact.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: NRS and other patient-reported outcomes (PROs) measures were administered when patients were in the dialysis unit by study staff who were specifically trained and certified on the methods of administration.

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial pre-specified its endpoints and analytical plan (including the step-down testing hierarchy and MMRM model) with results reported according to plan.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The primary endpoint was the change from baseline to treatment weeks 7 and 8 in itching intensity on an NRS in the modified intent-to-treat, population... A prespecified step-down procedure was used.

overall_summary: Overall risk of bias is judged as some concerns due to significant and differential attrition across study arms (35-42% dropout in nalbuphine groups vs. 19% in placebo), primarily driven by adverse events during dose titration. All other domains were well conducted with low risk of bias.

design_rationale: The paper reports two multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trials evaluating nalfurafine versus placebo for uremic pruritus.

domain_judgments.rationale: Although participants were described as randomly assigned and baseline characteristics were reported as comparable, the method of sequence generation and allocation concealment was not detailed.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Two multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical studies were performed with the common objective of assessing the efficacy and the safety of nalfurafine, as compared with placebo, in the treatment of uremic pruritus.

domain_judgments.rationale: The trials were double-blind with identical administration procedures for placebo and active treatment, and analyses were conducted on full analysis sets consistent with intention-to-treat principles.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Each dose of double-blind study medication in both studies was administered as an intravenous infusion at a rate of 2 ml/min for 5 min using an infusion pump. All doses were administered immediately after conclusion of each HD session.

domain_judgments.rationale: Completion rates were very high (74 of 79 in Study 1 and 31 of 34 in Study 2) with minimal missing outcome data across both groups.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: All patients who had received at least one dose of study medication and had at least one assessable 'worst itching' VAS measurement were included in a FAS data set... For any missing data, the last observation carried forward approach was used.

domain_judgments.rationale: The primary outcome was patient-reported visual analogue scale (VAS), and because both patients and assessors were successfully blinded with a placebo control, outcome assessment is unlikely to be biased.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The severity of pruritus and the treatment effectiveness were selfevaluated by the patients every 12 h during the run-in period and throughout the studies using a 100-mm VAS to measure the “worst itching” during the previous 12 h as the primary end point.

domain_judgments.rationale: The primary and secondary endpoints and analysis models were prespecified and reported as planned.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The primary end point for each of the clinical trials was reduction in mean 'worst itching' VAS from run-in to the end of week 4 (study 1) and week 2 (study 2). This end point was prespecified before the initiation of either trial.

overall_summary: The overall judgment is some concerns due to the lack of reporting on sequence generation and allocation concealment methods in Domain 1, despite robust blinding, low attrition, and prespecified analysis methods across both trials.

design_rationale: Eligible participants were randomly assigned in a 1:1:1:1 ratio to one of three doses of difelikefalin or placebo using a Web Response System.

domain_judgments.rationale: A centralized Web Response System was used for allocation with stratification, ensuring adequate concealment, and baseline characteristics were well-balanced across treatment groups.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Eligible patients were stratified according to their use or nonuse of antipruritic medications during the week before randomization, and randomized (1:1:1:1 ratio using a Web Response System) to receive an i.v. bolus of difelikefalin (0.5, 1.0, or 1.5 mg/kg) or placebo in isotonic acetate buffer (pH 4.5) at the end of each hemodialysis session for 8 weeks.

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial was double-blinded with matching placebo, blinding of patients and trial personnel was maintained, and analyses were conducted on the full analysis set according to assigned treatment.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Patients, investigators, clinical study site staff, and sponsor staff directly involved with the study were masked to treatment assignment throughout the trial.

domain_judgments.rationale: Discontinuation rates were low and balanced across groups (Figure 1 shows 37/45 placebo, 36/44 0.5 mcg/kg, 35/41 1.0 mcg/kg, and 33/44 1.5 mcg/kg completed the 8-week treatment period), and mixed-effects models for repeated measures were appropriately employed.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: In the primary efficacy analysis, missing daily worst itching scores were not imputed. Assuming the data were missing at random, the estimates of the treatment differences calculated from the mixed effects model with repeated measures without imputation are unbiased.

domain_judgments.rationale: Although the primary outcome was patient-reported, participants remained blinded to treatment assignment, minimizing the risk of bias in outcome measurement.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: All patient-reported outcomes were completed on paper before study drug administration at the dialysis center during hemodialysis sessions, except for the WI-NRS, which was also completed at home (at a similar time each day) on nondialysis days. Questionnaires were completed by each patient without any assistance.

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial was prospectively registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02858726), prespecified the primary and secondary endpoints and analyses, and reported results consistent with the prespecified protocol.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: This was a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 2 trial (ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT02858726) to assess the efficacy and safety of difelikefalin over an 8-week treatment period in hemodialysis patients with moderate-to-severe pruritus to identify an optimal dose for chronic use.

overall_summary: All five RoB 2 domains were evaluated as low risk of bias due to sound centralized randomization, effective double-blinding, minimal and balanced missing data analyzed with MMRM, and adherence to a prespecified trial registration protocol.

design_rationale: Participants were randomly assigned (1:1:1) to 5 µg nalfurafine, 2.5 µg nalfurafine, or placebo using a variable size permuted block design stratified by centre.

domain_judgments.rationale: A variable size permuted block design stratified by centre was utilized, allocation concealment is inherent in the double-blind multi-centre design, and baseline characteristics across groups were well balanced.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Those patients who met the above criteria were randomized 1:1:1 to receive 5 μg, 2.5 μg nalfurafine or a placebo using a variable size permuted block design stratified by centre.

domain_judgments.rationale: The study used identical-appearing soft capsules in a double-blind placebo-controlled design with high adherence and an appropriate full analysis set (FAS) resembling intention-to-treat.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The efficacy and safety of nalfurafine hydrochloride (a novel κ-receptor agonist) were prospectively investigated by randomly (1:1:1) administering 5 or 2.5 μg of the drug or a placebo orally for 14 days using a double-blind design in 337 haemodialysis patients... The patients took the soft capsules containing the drug or placebo once daily after supper for 14 days.

domain_judgments.rationale: Study completion was very high (97.6%), missing outcome data were minimal (only 2-3 patients per group discontinued), and all 337 participants who received the study drug were included in the primary FAS analysis.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: A total of 337 patients received the study drugs in the study: 114 patients (111 patients completed treatment) in 5-μg nalfurafine group, 112 (109 completed treatment) in 2.5-μg nalfurafine group and 111 (109 completed treatment) in the placebo group. The percentage of patients who completed the study was 97.6%.

domain_judgments.rationale: Although pruritus VAS is a patient-reported outcome, successful double-blinding with placebo capsules minimized any risk of bias in outcome measurement.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The patients were asked to mark the VAS value to record the worst de gree of itch experienced during the previous 12 h twice a day (once in the morning and once in the evening) throughout the study period (for 36 days).

domain_judgments.rationale: The primary endpoint and hierarchical statistical testing strategy were pre-specified in the study protocol and reported consistently.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The primary endpoint was defined as the change from the mean VAS value of the last 7 days of the pre-observation period and the mean VAS value of the latter 7 days of the treatment period... The hierarchical order for testing the null hypotheses was pre-specified in the protocol.

overall_summary: This double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trial had robust randomization, successful blinding, very low attrition (97.6% completion), and pre-specified outcome analyses, indicating a low risk of bias across all domains.

design_rationale: The study is described as a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 3 trial where eligible patients were randomly assigned (1:1) using an interactive Web-response system.

domain_judgments.rationale: Randomization was centrally managed via an interactive Web-response system, ensuring allocation sequence concealment, and baseline characteristics were well-balanced between groups.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Eligible patients were randomly assigned (in a 1:1 ratio) to receive intravenous difelikefalin (at a dose of 0.5 μg per kilogram of body weight) or matched placebo three times per week for 12 weeks... Randomization was performed with the use of an interactive Web-response system and was stratified according to baseline use of concomitant antipruritic medications and history of prespecified medical conditions.

domain_judgments.rationale: Patients and trial personnel remained blinded to treatment assignments with matched placebo, and analyses were conducted according to the intention-to-treat principle.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Patients, research staff, and the sponsor (Cara Therapeutics) trial team remained unaware of the trial-group assignments at all times... All the efficacy analyses were conducted in the intention-to-treat population, which was defined as all the patients who underwent randomization.

domain_judgments.rationale: Follow-up was high (observed data in 158 of 189 and 165 of 189 patients), missing data were addressed appropriately using multiple imputation, and sensitivity analyses confirmed the robustness of the findings.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: In the primary analysis, missing weekly mean WI-NRS scores were estimated with the use of multiple imputation under a missing-at-random assumption... Sensitivity analyses were performed to assess the robustness of the primary efficacy analysis under different missing-data assumptions and imputation algorithms (Appendix D in the Supplementary Appendix).

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcomes were assessed using validated patient-reported rating scales completed without assistance by blinded participants.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: During the 12-week intervention period, patients reported their worst itching intensity over the past 24 hours daily using the WI-NRS... Questionnaires were completed by each patient without any assistance... Patients, research staff, and the sponsor (Cara Therapeutics) trial team remained unaware of the trial-group assignments at all times.

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial had a pre-registered protocol and statistical analysis plan with a prespecified primary outcome, secondary outcomes tested in a defined hierarchical sequence, and reported results aligned with the protocol.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The primary efficacy outcome was the percentage of patients who had an improvement (decrease) of at least 3 points from baseline at week 12 in the weekly mean score on the daily WI-NRS... To control the type I error, a gatekeeping strategy was implemented... All the efficacy analyses were conducted in the intention-to-treat population... The statistical analysis plan is available with the protocol.

overall_summary: The trial was a well-conducted, double-blind, randomized placebo-controlled study with concealed allocation, low attrition addressed by appropriate imputation and sensitivity analyses, blinded outcome assessments, and adherence to a prespecified analysis protocol, resulting in low risk of bias across all RoB 2 domains.
